title: Mining Intrinsic Rewards from LLM Hidden States for Efficient Best-of-N Sampling
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating the performance of a reward model (SWIFT) on tasks related to mathematical reasoning, code comprehension, commonsense abilities, and symbolic reasoning.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on improving LLM performance in reasoning and general tasks through a novel reward modeling technique.
